store.name: Jan's Store
store.author: Jan
store.description: Dynaframe Plugins made by AI - Please note: I used AI exclusively to create this; I am not a coder and cannot check the code for potential vulnerabilities.

packs.title: Playlist Button
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: GPIO button to select playlists via an overlay menu

packs.title: Web Page Button
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: GPIO button that opens a web page full screen on top of the slideshow and closes it again with the next press

packs.title: Jellyfin Now Playing
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Shows what a chosen Jellyfin user is watching or listening to, on the whole screen, for as long as it plays: cover, backdrop, title, episode, year, genres, plot and progress. Installs the plugin together with its scene. All settings on its own plugin page, in German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Fußball Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Live scores, matchdays and tables for Bundesliga, Champions League, English, Scottish and Spanish leagues and cups, the World Cup and more. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes. Pick your club to show its crest in the background and its colours as accent. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: American Football Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Live scores, weeks and standings for the NFL, College Football (Top 25, SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC), UFL and CFL. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes or on a touchdown. Pick your team to show its logo in the background and its colours as accent. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: World Map Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: A calm world map with borders, day and night and the day-night line that shows real aircraft, ships, lightning strikes and the ISS live: aircraft from the OpenSky Network (no account needed), ships from up to five sources you can switch on and off (AISStream.io with a free API key, Kystverket for Norway and Digitraffic for the Baltic Sea without sign-up, AISHub, or your own AIS receiver), lightning from the volunteer network Blitzortung.org, the ISS orbit from CelesTrak. Whole world or Europe, DACH, North America, South America, East Asia, Australia and Oceania. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Biathlon Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Biathlon results with shooting, live standings during a race, schedule, next venue and World Cup standings from the IBU (biathlonresults.com): World Cup, World Championships, IBU Cup and more. A rebuild of the MagicMirror module MMM-Biathlon by 2hdlockness. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes, at race start or when a result is in. Pick your nation to highlight its athletes. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Travel Map
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: A world map in the style of an old globe, studded with push pins where your photos were taken. The places come from the photos' GPS data: a DynaFrame playlist, the whole DynaFrame media library (plus extra folders such as a mounted NAS) or your Immich server (all photos or an album). Every collection gets its own pin colour and shape (push pin, thumbtack, flag, long pin); close pins are merged. The pins go in one by one in the order the photos were taken, then a photo is shown at its pin now and then with place and date. Oval world map or three globes, or only the area with pins. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Foto Cast
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Show the photo or video you are looking at on your phone on the frame right away, on iPhone and Android without an extra app: from the share menu of the Photos app or WhatsApp (iPhone shortcut), from an Android share app, or from the frame's phone page (QR code). Photos fill the screen for a few minutes, videos play once with sound, several take turns, then your playlist carries on. Phones pair once with a code shown on the frame, so nobody else on the Wi-Fi can send. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: YouTube Cast
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Cast YouTube videos from your phone to the frame, like to a TV: tap the cast button in the YouTube app and choose the frame (Android and iPhone, on the same Wi-Fi or once linked with a TV code). The app becomes the remote for pause, seek and volume. Links can also be sent from a phone page or the iPhone share menu. Afterwards your playlist carries on. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Dynaframe's Magic Mirror
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Inspired by MagicMirror² (github.com/MagicMirrorOrg/MagicMirror); not an official MagicMirror² project. Pick modules and place each one top, bottom, left, right or centre. Or switch the whole scene to a skin (Retro LCD clock, Colour grid, or add-on skins from the catalog, the store or a ZIP file) and choose what each of its fields shows. More modules (Guest Wi-Fi QR, WebUntis, Music Assistant, Jellyfin, river level) from the built-in module catalog. Build your own or port MagicMirror² modules, also with an AI: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: River level
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Water level of a gauge on German federal waterways (PEGELONLINE) with trend. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Guest Wi-Fi
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Network name, password and a QR code guests scan to join your Wi-Fi. Inspired by MMM-WiFiPassword. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: WebUntis timetable
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Next school days with substitutions and cancellations, exams, homework and messages from WebUntis. Inspired by MMM-Webuntis; not an official Untis product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Music Assistant
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). What's playing on your Music Assistant server with cover, progress and up next. Inspired by MMM-MusicAssistant. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Jellyfin now playing
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). What's playing on your Jellyfin server: music, movie, episode or live TV with cover, progress and up next. Not an official Jellyfin product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Settings Backup
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Saves the settings of all your plugins and scenes to one file and puts them back, on this frame or on another one. Missing stores are added and missing packs installed from the stores they came from, plugins without a store travel with their code, and settings take effect right away. With a password the file is encrypted and also carries API keys and passwords; without one they are left out. Every restore can be undone. German, English or Spanish.
